text_block_list.text:
It is finally my turn to race. Are you
ready?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I'd expect nothing less of my—I
mean... of
the trainer to an Umamusume
from the esteemed
Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm getting all fired up! This is just
the
amount of tension I need.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: For the dream I must fulfill... Here I go!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
